An authenticated die-interior context and exact catalog-to-manual binding are still required. Neither an IP name nor an empty frame marker alone proves that context. The remaining depmos.13 module-enclosure row does not acquire the F flag by association.

clarification_request.title: Clarify SKY130 x.20 pin spacing and die/frame applicability for local verification
clarification_request.body:
We are implementing local physical verification in the GPL-3.0-or-later [IC Design Studio](https://github.com/jonahsaunders/IC-Design-Studio) project. We are seeking publicly releasable specifications, not a waiver or a remote verification service.

At revision `e8fc249dc5d0a56a0cac5f04ecf618b2f634e9a7`, [p018-x_dotdash.csv](https://github.com/fossi-foundation/skywater-pdk/blob/e8fc249dc5d0a56a0cac5f04ecf618b2f634e9a7/docs/rules/periphery/p018-x_dotdash.csv) describes pin center spacing under `x.20`, enabled by `IP_block`, but leaves Value and Unit empty.

1. What limit, units, layer-dependent behavior and applicability define `x.20` for SKY130A? If this is an obsolete or unsupported option, is there a public version-specific statement to that effect?
2. The [flag definitions](https://skywater-pdk.readthedocs.io/en/main/rules/periphery.html) identify `F` rules as frame-only and exclude die interiors. What authoritative layout markers or declared design-context contract establish that distinction for an exported IP block? We want to avoid inferring an exemption merely from a missing frame or module marker.
3. Is there a public, appropriately licensed source for the generated-mask and RF recognition definitions referenced by the catalog, particularly CLNTM/CLHVNTM/CLHVTPM, fomDummyDRC, FGR, and the RF fixed-layout model map/Table H5? Pointers to existing issues or the correct maintainers would help.

Our [remaining-dependency inventory](https://github.com/jonahsaunders/IC-Design-Studio/blob/experimental/docs/validation/sky130-source-dependencies-2026-10-15.json) keeps unknown definitions unresolved. Passing a subset of checks is not being represented as full signoff.

Please share only information authorized for public release, with its applicable revision and license. We can implement original local checks and contribute positive/negative test cases once the requirements are established.
